connectors.name: polaris-oid4vp
connectors.description: An OpenID4VP 1.0 verifier under HAIP 1.0, from Polaris ID, that a relying party installs from PyPI and runs on its own servers, as a Python library or a command-line server. It requests an SD-JWT VC by DCQL over direct_post.jwt, checks the issuer's signature and the holder's key binding, can check an IETF Token Status List, and returns one verdict per presentation. polaris-oid4vp 1.0.0rc7 is OpenID Certified to the OpenID4VP 1.0 + HAIP 1.0 Verifier profile (sd_jwt_vc, direct_post.jwt).
